drafts.title: I checked 30 AI products against the EU AI Act. 22 failed before I even reached the technical questions.
drafts.text:
Background: I've been running EU AI Act checks on AI products partly because I kept hearing founders say 'it doesn't apply to us.' Article 2 says otherwise.

What I found across 30 products:
- 18/30 had a chatbot with a human name that never disclosed it was AI (Article 50, in force Aug 2025)
- 6/30 had emotion-inference features banned under Article 5 (in force Feb 2025)
- 8/30 were in high-risk categories (hiring, education, credit) and self-classified as minimal risk

High-risk deadline is August 2026 — 60 days away. Conformity assessments take 3-6 months.

Free 60-second check: https://tinytools-smoky.vercel.app/eu-ai-act-risk-assessment/blog/your-ai-product-is-probably-non-compliant-europe-right-now-60-seconds-2026/
